approval_time_estimate: None for basic scopes; some scopes need Discord approval
summary: Discord OAuth2 apps are created in the developer applications page and get a client ID and secret immediately. Basic scopes need no review, but some scopes are restricted to approved partners and verified bots have no server cap. Discord publishes OAuth discovery metadata, and tokens last about seven days.
key_facts: Register an application to get client_id and client_secret; a bot user is added to every app automatically
Some scopes require approval from Discord — e.g. dm_channels.read, voice and the rpc.* scopes are limited to approved partners
The bot flow does not need response_type or redirect_uri unless you request scopes beyond bot and applications.commands
Token and revoke requests must be application/x-www-form-urlencoded (not JSON); authenticate with HTTP Basic or client credentials in the body
Example token lifetime in the docs is 604800 seconds (7 days); use the refresh token to renew
The implicit grant returns no refresh token and is discouraged for production

steps.title: Create an application
steps.description: Register a developer application on the Discord developer applications page to obtain the client ID and secret.

steps.title: Add redirect URIs
steps.description: Register the redirect URI(s) on the application (for Composio: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback). Discord uses the first registered URI if you do not send redirect_uri.

steps.title: Pick scopes
steps.description: Request only the scopes you need. Scopes marked as partner-only cannot be used without Discord approval.
warnings: Check each scope in the docs for approval requirements

steps.title: Send users to authorize
steps.description: Redirect to https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize with client_id, scope, redirect_uri and response_type=code.

steps.title: Exchange the code
steps.description: POST (form-encoded) to https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token with grant_type=authorization_code; refresh later with grant_type=refresh_token.

blockers.title: Partner-only scopes
blockers.description: Some scopes (e.g. dm_channels.read, voice, rpc.*) are only available to approved partners; relationships.read must be requested through the Social SDK.
blockers.workaround: Design around the public scopes, or apply to Discord for access.

blockers.title: Bot verification at scale
blockers.description: Discord's docs say verified bots have no maximum server count and link to a verification guide, but do not detail the process.
blockers.workaround: Read the verification guide before planning for large bots.
